svg.title: One Feature, three repos
svg.desc: Two lanes. Hermes Agent: three separate boards, here split by repository, each with one card that works in one repo in one worktree; a gap between the boards is marked as unable to link. Yellowhammer: one Feature card and a Night Card on the Linear board; the Feature feeds three repository trays, web, server and mobile, and each ends in one sealed envelope, a pull request.
svg.text: One Feature, one pull request per repo
FIG 3 · ONE REPO PER CARD VS ONE FEATURE, ONE PR PER REPO
